intervals.label: data taking
intervals.note: Month precision from 'at the end of 1980' (approximate). The same sentence gives 1600 proportional counters, 140 t of iron and the 7000 hg/cm^2 depth.
intervals.quote: This 'Phase I' detector which comprised of 1600 proportional counters having a total weight of 140 tons of iron, was installed deep underground at the depth of 7000 hg/cm2 and started making observations on possible proton decay phenomenon at the end of 1980.

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: The paper says the proton-decay experiment stopped data taking in 1993; it does not give a separate retirement date for this detector.
intervals.quote: Since the management of KGF mines decided to start closing the mines in 1993, the proton decay experiment stopped data taking in 1993.

placements.note: Placed at the Kolar Gold Fields site; the mine level and shaft are not given by any source consulted (the depth is in the specs).
placements.quote: was installed deep underground at the depth of 7000 hg/cm2

depth.quote: was installed deep underground at the depth of 7000 hg/cm2

total_mass.quote: This 'Phase I' detector which comprised of 1600 proportional counters having a total weight of 140 tons of iron, was installed deep underground at the depth of 7000 hg/cm2 and started making observations on possible proton decay phenomenon at the end of 1980.

summary.plain: The first KGF proton-decay detector: 34 layers of gas-filled iron counters and iron plates, about 140 tons, installed very deep in the mine and running from the end of 1980.
summary.technical: Phase I: about 1600 iron-walled proportional counters (10 cm x 10 cm, 2.3 mm walls, 4 m or 6 m long) in 34 crossed layers with 1.2 cm iron plates, 4 x 6 m^2 floor area, 140 t, at 7000 hg/cm^2.

technology.quote: Proportional counters of 10 x 10 cm cross sectional area, 2.3 mm thick iron walls and 4 m or 6 m length were placed in alternate horizontal layers in a crossed layer configuration.
technology.value: Iron-walled proportional counters in crossed horizontal layers interleaved with iron plates
